items.title: 语法一致原则
items.brief: 默认规则：谓语跟主语中心词的单复数

concept.summary: 语法一致是默认规则：谓语的单复数由主语中心词的形式决定。判定顺序固定为四步：先划掉主语后的修饰成分找到中心词；再排查 or/nor/but also 类结构（触发就近）；再排查 as well as/together with 类结构（触发就远）；两类结构都没有时，才按中心词的形式定单复数。冲突时的优先级是：就近与就远（结构触发）高于意义一致，意义一致高于语法一致。

sections.p: 主语后面的介词短语、定语从句、同位语、插入语都不改变主语的数。判定时先把这些成分整体划掉，剩下的名词才是中心词。这一步做错，后面三步全部失效。
bullets: The box of chocolates is on the table.（中心词 box，不是 chocolates）
The results of the survey show a clear trend.（中心词 results）
Nobody in the two classes knows the answer.（中心词 nobody）
The teacher, as well as the students, was invited.（中心词 teacher）

sections.h: 四步判定顺序与优先级
sections.p: 顺序不可颠倒，因为前一步会改写「谁算主语」，后一步只在没有结构触发时才起作用。做题时按下面的编号走一遍，不要凭语感跳步。
bullets: ① 划掉 of 短语、定语从句、同位语、插入语，找出中心词
② 主语由 or / either...or / neither...nor / not only...but also / not...but 连接 → 用就近原则
③ 主语后有 as well as / along with / together with / rather than / except / including → 用就远原则
④ 前两步都不触发：形式与意义一致时按语法一致；形式与意义冲突时按意义一致
优先级：就近/就远 ＞ 意义一致 ＞ 语法一致

sections.h: 只有这两类谓语体现单复数
sections.p: 并不是所有谓语都能看出主谓是否一致。一般现在时的实义动词与 be 动词的现在式、过去式才有单复数差别；情态动词、过去式实义动词没有形式变化，改错时不要在这些位置硬找一致错误。
bullets: 一般现在时：He works. / They work.
be 动词：He is. / They are.；He was. / They were.
情态动词无单复数：He can swim. / They can swim.
过去式实义动词无单复数：He left. / They left.

examples.en: The list of items has been updated.
examples.zh: 物品清单已经更新。
examples.note: 中心词是 list，单数，of items 只是修饰语，谓语用 has。

examples.en: The results of the survey show a clear trend.
examples.zh: 调查结果显示出清晰的趋势。
examples.note: 中心词是 results，复数，谓语用 show。

examples.en: Each of the participants was given a name tag.
examples.zh: 每位参与者都发到了一个姓名牌。
examples.note: each 是单数中心词，of the participants 不改变数。

examples.en: The teacher, as well as the students, was surprised by the news.
examples.zh: 老师和学生们一样，都被这个消息惊到了。
examples.note: as well as 短语不参与一致，谓语跟 teacher，用 was。

examples.en: The quality of the products have improved.
examples.zh: 产品的质量有所提高。
examples.note: 中心词是 quality，单数，谓语应改为 has improved。

examples.en: One of my friends are a doctor.
examples.zh: 我的一个朋友是医生。
examples.note: 中心词是 one，单数，谓语应改为 is。

examples.en: The news about the accident was shocking.
examples.zh: 关于这场事故的消息令人震惊。
examples.note: news 形式上是复数但语法上是单数名词，谓语用 was。

pitfalls.wrong: The number of visitors have doubled.
pitfalls.right: The number of visitors has doubled.
pitfalls.why: 主语中心词是 number，单数；of visitors 只是修饰语，不参与一致。

pitfalls.wrong: Everyone in the two teams know the rules.
pitfalls.right: Everyone in the two teams knows the rules.
pitfalls.why: everyone 是单数不定代词，介词短语 in the two teams 不改变它的数。

pitfalls.wrong: The news about the accident were shocking.
pitfalls.right: The news about the accident was shocking.
pitfalls.why: news 虽以 s 结尾，但语法上是单数名词，谓语用单数。

contrast.diff: 语法一致看中心词的形式；意义一致看主语所表达的数量概念，二者冲突时意义一致优先。

concept.mnemonic: 先划 of 短语找中心，再查 or 与 as well as，四步走完才看形式。

core: 默认规则：谓语与主语中心词的单复数一致
第一步永远是划掉 of 短语、定语从句、同位语、插入语
判定顺序：找中心词 → 查就近结构 → 查就远结构 → 才按形式
优先级：就近/就远 ＞ 意义一致 ＞ 语法一致
只有一般现在时与 be 动词才体现单复数，情态动词与过去式没有形式差异
review.trigger: 看到主语带 of 短语，先划掉整个短语，只看 of 前的中心词

quickCheck.q: The box of chocolates ___ (be) on the table. 填什么？
四步判定顺序是什么？
quickCheck.a: 找中心词 → 查就近结构 → 查就远结构 → 按形式或意义定。

quickCheck.q: The teacher, as well as the students, ___ (be) invited. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: was，as well as 短语不参与一致。

drills.stem: The quality of the online courses ___ improved a lot since last year.
drills.answer: has
drills.explain: 主语中心词是 quality，单数；of the online courses 只是修饰语。按语法一致原则，现在完成时的助动词用 has。
drills.trap: have 是被紧邻的复数 courses 带偏，误把修饰语当成了中心词。

drills.stem: Each of the students ___ (receive) a copy of the syllabus on the first day.
drills.answer: receives
drills.hint: 先划掉 of the students，再看剩下的中心词。
drills.explain: 触发语法一致原则：中心词 each 是单数，of the students 只是修饰语，谓语用第三人称单数 receives。

drills.stem: The list of names were posted on the notice board.
drills.answer: The list of names was posted on the notice board.
accept: The list of names was posted on the notice board.
drills.explain: 中心词是 list，单数，of names 只是修饰语；被动语态的 be 动词须用 was。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The results of the survey show a clear trend.
drills.explain: 中心词 results 是复数，of the survey 是修饰语，谓语用 show。

drills.stem: 这些产品的质量有了明显提高。
drills.answer: The quality of these products has improved noticeably.
drills.explain: 主语中心词是 quality，单数，of these products 不参与一致，谓语用 has improved。

drills.stem: The news about the merger ___ released yesterday afternoon.
drills.answer: was
drills.explain: news 形式上是复数但语法上是单数名词，按语法一致原则用 was；yesterday afternoon 也要求过去时。
drills.trap: were 只看到词尾的 s 就判定为复数，忽略了 news 的单数属性。

items.title: 意义一致原则
items.brief: 形式与意义冲突时，按主语实际表示的数量定谓语

concept.summary: 意义一致在主语形式与所表达的数量冲突时启用：谓语跟「主语实际指多少」走，不跟词尾走。触发场景固定为五类：集合名词、the + 形容词、表示时间距离金额的复数名词、以 s 结尾的学科与疾病名、书名与专有名称。它在判定顺序中排在就近/就远之后、语法一致之前：没有结构触发时才启用，一旦启用即压过形式。

sections.p: 这五类有一个共同点：词形与所指数量不一致。看到任何一类，先问「它指的是一个整体还是一群个体」，再定谓语。
bullets: 集合名词：family, team, class, government, committee, audience, staff, public
the + 形容词：the rich/poor/old/wounded 指人用复数；the unknown/beautiful 指抽象用单数
时间、距离、金额、重量：Ten years is a long time. / Five kilometres is too far to walk.
学科与疾病：Mathematics is difficult. / Measles is infectious.
书名与专有名称：The Arabian Nights is a classic. / The United States is a large country.

sections.p: 意义一致不是第一顺位。先排查 or/nor 类（就近）与 as well as 类（就远），两者都不触发时，才判断形式与意义是否冲突。只有冲突存在，意义一致才生效，而且它一旦生效就优先于形式。
bullets: 无冲突：The students are here.（形式复数、意义复数，直接用语法一致）
有冲突：The police are investigating.（形式单数、意义复数 → 意义一致）
有冲突：Ten years is a long time.（形式复数、意义单数 → 意义一致）
优先级：就近/就远 ＞ 意义一致 ＞ 语法一致

sections.p: 集合名词用单数还是复数，取决于谓语动作能否由成员分别执行、以及代词是否用 they/their 回指。句中一旦出现 their、among themselves、each other，谓语必须用复数。
bullets: The committee has reached a decision.（作为整体，单数）
The committee were divided on the issue.（成员意见不一，复数）
The audience was deeply moved.（整体感受，单数）
The audience were chatting with each other.（成员各自行动，复数）

examples.en: The committee has reached a decision.
examples.zh: 委员会已经作出决定。
examples.note: 委员会作为整体行动，按意义一致用单数 has。

examples.en: The committee were divided on the issue.
examples.zh: 委员会在这个问题上意见分歧。
examples.note: 成员各自持不同意见，按意义一致用复数 were。

examples.en: Ten thousand dollars is more than I can afford.
examples.zh: 一万美元超出了我的承受能力。
examples.note: 金额被视为一个总量，谓语用单数 is。

examples.en: Mathematics is her favourite subject.
examples.zh: 数学是她最喜欢的科目。
examples.note: 学科名虽以 s 结尾，指一门学科，谓语用单数。

examples.en: The police is investigating the case.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查这起案件。
examples.note: police 形式单数、意义复数，谓语应改为 are。

examples.en: Twenty years are a long time.
examples.zh: 二十年是很长一段时间。
examples.note: 时间段被视为一个整体，谓语应改为 is。

examples.en: The audience were chatting with each other before the show.
examples.zh: 演出开始前观众们在互相聊天。
examples.note: each other 说明成员各自行动，按意义一致用复数。

pitfalls.wrong: The family is all fond of music.
pitfalls.right: The family are all fond of music.
pitfalls.why: all 说明每个成员各自如此，谓语改用复数，family 在此被解释为一群个体。

pitfalls.wrong: Five hundred kilometres are a long distance.
pitfalls.right: Five hundred kilometres is a long distance.
pitfalls.why: 距离作为整体量看待，谓语用单数，不受 kilometres 复数形式影响。

pitfalls.wrong: The United States are a large country.
pitfalls.right: The United States is a large country.
pitfalls.why: 国名虽为复数形式，指一个国家，谓语用单数。

contrast.diff: 语法一致看中心词词尾的单复数；意义一致看主语实际指的数量，冲突时意义一致优先。

concept.mnemonic: 词形与所指打架，听所指的；整体用单数，成员用复数，看能不能用 they 指代。

core: 触发条件：主语形式与所表达的数量概念冲突
五类场景：集合名词、the + 形容词、时间距离金额、学科疾病、书名专名
集合名词：整体用单数，成员用复数，看能否用 they/their 指代
时间、距离、金额视为整体，谓语用单数
优先级：就近/就远 ＞ 意义一致 ＞ 语法一致
review.trigger: 看到 -s 结尾却是单数概念，或单数形式却指一群人，立刻启用意义一致

quickCheck.q: The police ___ (be) investigating. 填什么？
Ten years ___ (be) a long time. 填什么？
什么时候集合名词用复数谓语？
quickCheck.a: 强调成员各自行动、能用 they/their 回指时。

drills.stem: The police ___ questioning the witnesses at the station right now.
drills.answer: are
drills.explain: police 形式上是单数、意义上指一群警察，按意义一致原则谓语用复数 are。
drills.trap: is 只按词形判断，忽略了 police 的集合属性，且与后面的复数语境不符。

drills.stem: Ten thousand dollars ___ (be) far more than we can afford.
drills.answer: is
drills.hint: 金额被当作一个总量还是一个一个的美元？
drills.explain: 触发意义一致原则：金额被视为一个整体总量，谓语用单数 is，而不是跟复数 dollars 一致。

drills.stem: Mathematics are considered the most difficult subject in our school.
drills.answer: Mathematics is considered the most difficult subject in our school.
accept: Mathematics is considered the most difficult subject in our school.
drills.explain: Mathematics 虽以 s 结尾，指一门学科，按意义一致原则作单数，谓语用 is。

drills.stem: The audience ___ on their feet, applauding wildly.
drills.answer: were
drills.explain: on their feet 与 applauding 说明观众各自行动，their 也要求复数回指，按意义一致原则用 were。
drills.trap: was 把 audience 当作一个整体，与后面的 their 冲突。

drills.stem: 警方正在调查这起事故。
drills.answer: The police are investigating the accident.
drills.explain: police 是形式单数、意义复数的集合名词，按意义一致原则谓语用 are。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Twenty years is a long time.
drills.explain: 时间段被视为一个整体概念，按意义一致原则谓语用单数 is。

items.title: 就近原则
items.brief: or/nor/not only 结构里谓语跟最近的主语

concept.summary: 就近原则只在一组固定结构里生效：主语由 or、either...or、neither...nor、not only...but also、not...but 连接，或 there be 后接并列名词时，谓语与最靠近它的那个主语一致。它是结构触发规则，优先级高于意义一致与语法一致，因为它在判定顺序上更早改写了「谁算主语」。

sections.p: 触发词是唯一入口。没有这些连接词，任何「离谓语最近的名词」都不构成就近，包括介词短语里的名词。
bullets: A or B → 谓语跟 B
either A or B → 谓语跟 B
neither A nor B → 谓语跟 B
not only A but also B → 谓语跟 B
not A but B → 谓语跟 B
there be + A and B → 谓语跟 A

sections.p: 就近排在第二位：找完中心词就立刻检查有没有这些连接词。一旦命中，直接取最近的主语，不再看整体意义，也不再退回语法一致。这就是它优先级最高的原因。
bullets: Neither the students nor the teacher was informed.（跟 teacher）
Neither the teacher nor the students were informed.（跟 students）
Either you or I am responsible for the mistake.
There is a pen and two books on the desk.

sections.p: 第一，把介词短语里的名词当成最近的主语；第二，把 either of / neither of 当作就近结构。后者没有 or/nor 连接两个主语，中心词是 either/neither 本身，一律用单数。
bullets: × Neither of the answers are correct. → √ Neither of the answers is correct.
× Either of the two roads lead to the village. → √ leads
The teacher, with two students, was late.（不是就近，with 短语不构成并列主语）

examples.en: Either you or I am responsible for the mistake.
examples.zh: 要么是你，要么是我，该为这个错误负责。
examples.note: either...or 触发就近，最近的主语是 I，be 动词用 am。

examples.en: Not only the coach but also the players were satisfied.
examples.zh: 不仅教练满意，队员们也很满意。
examples.note: but also 后最近的 the players 是复数，谓语用 were。

examples.en: Neither the manager nor his assistants have replied.
examples.zh: 经理和他的助理们都没有回复。
examples.note: nor 后最近的 assistants 是复数，谓语用 have。

examples.en: There is a lamp and two chairs in the corner.
examples.zh: 角落里有一盏灯和两把椅子。
examples.note: there be 按就近与 a lamp 一致，用 is。

examples.en: Neither the teacher nor the students was present.
examples.zh: 老师和学生们都没有到场。
examples.note: nor 后最近的 students 是复数，谓语应改为 were。

examples.en: Either the twins or their mother have the keys.
examples.zh: 要么是双胞胎，要么是他们的母亲拿着钥匙。
examples.note: or 后最近的 their mother 是单数，谓语应改为 has。

examples.en: There are two chairs and a lamp in the corner.
examples.zh: 角落里有两把椅子和一盏灯。
examples.note: there be 按就近与 two chairs 一致，用 are。

pitfalls.wrong: Not only the students but also the teacher were excited.
pitfalls.right: Not only the students but also the teacher was excited.
pitfalls.why: but also 后最近的 the teacher 是单数，就近原则要求谓语跟它一致。

pitfalls.wrong: Neither of the answers are correct.
pitfalls.right: Neither of the answers is correct.
pitfalls.why: neither of 没有 or/nor 连接两个主语，中心词是 neither，按语法一致用单数。

pitfalls.wrong: The teacher with two students were late for the meeting.
pitfalls.right: The teacher with two students was late for the meeting.
pitfalls.why: with 短语是附加说明，不构成并列主语，不属于就近结构，谓语跟 teacher。

contrast.diff: 就近看紧邻谓语的那个并列主语，由 or/nor/but also 触发；就远看第一个主语，由 as well as/together with 触发。

concept.mnemonic: or、nor、but also，只盯挨着谓语的那一个。

core: 触发词：or、either...or、neither...nor、not only...but also、not...but
触发时谓语跟最靠近它的主语，不看整体
there be 后接并列名词也按就近，谓语跟第一个名词
优先级最高：就近 ＞ 意义一致 ＞ 语法一致
either of / neither of 不是就近结构，中心词单数，谓语用单数
review.trigger: 看到 or、nor、but also，立刻只盯紧挨谓语的那个主语

quickCheck.q: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ (be) present. 填什么？
Neither of the answers ___ (be) correct. 填什么？
There is a pen and two books 为什么用 is？
quickCheck.a: there be 按就近与第一个名词 a pen 一致。

drills.stem: Neither the students nor the teacher ___ aware of the change in schedule.
drills.answer: was
drills.explain: neither...nor 触发就近原则，紧邻谓语的 the teacher 是单数，谓语用 was。
drills.trap: were 是按前面的复数 students 判断，忽略了 nor 之后才是最近的并列主语。

drills.stem: Not only the manager but also his assistants ___ (be) going to attend the conference.
drills.answer: are
drills.hint: 看 but also 之后的名词，而不是 but also 之前的名词。
drills.explain: 触发就近原则：but also 后最近的 his assistants 是复数，谓语用 are。

drills.stem: Either the coach or the players has to take responsibility.
drills.answer: Either the coach or the players have to take responsibility.
accept: Either the coach or the players have to take responsibility.
drills.explain: either...or 触发就近原则，or 后最近的 the players 是复数，谓语用 have。

drills.stem: There ___ a notebook and several pens on the teacher's desk.
drills.answer: is
drills.explain: there be 后接并列名词时按就近原则，与第一个名词 a notebook 一致，用 is。
drills.trap: are 按并列名词的整体复数判断，没有走就近。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Neither the teacher nor the students were late.
drills.explain: nor 后最近的 the students 是复数，按就近原则谓语用 were。

drills.stem: 要么你去，要么我去。
drills.answer: Either you or I am going.
drills.explain: either...or 触发就近原则，最近的主语是 I，be 动词用 am。

items.title: 就远原则
items.brief: 附加短语不参与一致，谓语跟第一个主语

concept.summary: 就远原则用于主语后接伴随、附加、排除类短语的结构：as well as、along with、together with、rather than、except、besides、including、accompanied by、in addition to。这些短语只是附加说明，不参与主谓一致，谓语仍与它们前面的第一个主语一致。

sections.p: 这些短语的共同点是「删掉后句子仍完整」，语义上是插入信息而非并列主语。判定时直接把它们连同后面的名词一起划掉。
bullets: as well as / along with / together with
rather than / except / but / besides
including / in addition to / accompanied by / no less than
由逗号夹注是视觉信号，但判定依据是短语本身，不是逗号

sections.p: 这类短语在语法上不构成并列主语，第一个主语才是中心词。删掉短语后剩下的句子仍然成立，这就是最快的验证方法。
bullets: The teacher, as well as the students, was invited.（删去短语 → The teacher was invited.）
Nobody but the two guards knows the code.
The house, along with its garden, was sold.
The students, rather than their teacher, were responsible.

sections.p: 两者由不同连接词触发，不能混用。or/nor/but also 连接的是并列主语，按就近；as well as/together with 连接的是附加成分，按就远。两者同为结构触发，优先级相同，都高于意义一致与语法一致。
bullets: 就近触发：or, either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also
就远触发：as well as, along with, together with, rather than, except
优先级：就近/就远 ＞ 意义一致 ＞ 语法一致
with 短语同样属于附加成分：The teacher with two students was late.

examples.en: The manager, together with his assistants, has submitted the report.
examples.zh: 经理连同他的助理们已经提交了报告。
examples.note: together with 短语不参与一致，谓语跟 manager，用 has。

examples.en: The students, as well as their teacher, were excited about the trip.
examples.zh: 学生们和他们的老师一样，都对这次旅行感到兴奋。
examples.note: 中心词是 students，谓语用 were；as well as 短语只是附加信息。

examples.en: Nobody except the two monitors knows the password.
examples.zh: 除了两个班长，没人知道密码。
examples.note: nobody 是单数中心词，except 短语只是排除说明。

examples.en: The village, along with its surrounding farms, was flooded.
examples.zh: 这个村子连同周边的农场都被淹了。
examples.note: 中心词是 village，单数，谓语用 was。

examples.en: The teacher as well as the students were late.
examples.zh: 老师和学生们都迟到了。
examples.note: as well as 不构成并列主语，谓语应改为 was，与 teacher 一致。

examples.en: The students together with their teacher was excited.
examples.zh: 学生们和他们的老师都很兴奋。
examples.note: 中心词是 students，谓语应改为 were。

examples.en: Rather than his parents, John is responsible for the decision.
examples.zh: 该为这个决定负责的是约翰，而不是他的父母。
examples.note: rather than 短语在句首，主语仍是 John，谓语用 is。

pitfalls.wrong: The CEO, along with the board members, have agreed to the plan.
pitfalls.right: The CEO, along with the board members, has agreed to the plan.
pitfalls.why: along with 短语不改变主语的数，中心词是单数 the CEO。

pitfalls.wrong: No one but the two boys were injured.
pitfalls.right: No one but the two boys was injured.
pitfalls.why: no one 是单数中心词，but 引导的短语只是排除说明，不参与一致。

pitfalls.wrong: The equipment, as well as the manuals, were delivered yesterday.
pitfalls.right: The equipment, as well as the manuals, was delivered yesterday.
pitfalls.why: equipment 是不可数名词，中心词单数，as well as 短语不影响谓语。

contrast.diff: 就近由 or/nor/but also 触发，谓语跟最近的主语；就远由 as well as/together with 触发，谓语跟第一个主语。

concept.mnemonic: as well as 是附加，删掉短语看前面；or 与 nor 是并列，盯住后面那一个。

core: 触发短语：as well as、along with、together with、rather than、except、besides、including、accompanied by
这些短语是附加说明，不构成并列主语
判定动作：把短语连同其后名词整体删掉，剩下的主语定谓语
就远与就近同为结构触发，优先级都高于意义一致和语法一致
逗号夹注只是视觉信号，判定依据是短语本身
review.trigger: 看到 as well as / together with，先划掉整个短语，谓语跟前面的主语

quickCheck.q: The teacher, together with the students, ___ (be) invited. 填什么？
Nobody but the two guards ___ (know) the code. 填什么？
就远原则最快的验证方法是什么？
quickCheck.a: 把短语连同其后名词删掉，看剩下的主语。

drills.stem: The professor, together with his research assistants, ___ the experiment next week.
drills.answer: is to repeat
drills.explain: 就远原则：together with 短语不参与一致，中心词 professor 是单数，谓语用 is to repeat。
drills.trap: are to repeat 跟了最近的复数 assistants，把附加成分误当并列主语。

drills.stem: The students, as well as their teacher, ___ (be) looking forward to the trip.
drills.answer: are
drills.hint: 把 as well as 短语整体划掉，再看剩下的主语。
drills.explain: 触发就远原则：as well as their teacher 是附加成分，中心词 students 为复数，谓语用 are。

drills.stem: The CEO, along with the board members, have agreed to the new plan.
drills.answer: The CEO, along with the board members, has agreed to the new plan.
accept: The CEO, along with the board members, has agreed to the new plan.
drills.explain: along with 短语不参与主谓一致，中心词是单数 the CEO，现在完成时的助动词用 has。

drills.stem: Nobody but the two guards ___ the code to the safe.
drills.answer: knows
drills.explain: nobody 是单数中心词，but 引导的短语只是排除说明，按就远原则谓语用 knows。
drills.trap: know 受了最近复数 guards 的影响，把排除说明当成了并列主语。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The house, along with its garden, was sold.
drills.explain: along with its garden 是附加成分，中心词 the house 为单数，谓语用 was。

drills.stem: 校长和学生们都出席了开幕式。
drills.answer: The principal, as well as the students, was present at the opening ceremony.
forbid: as well as the students were
drills.explain: as well as the students 是附加成分，不参与一致，中心词 principal 为单数，按就远原则用 was。

items.title: and 连接主语的一致问题
items.brief: and 连接两个主语通常用复数，同指一人除外

concept.summary: and 连接两个不同的人或物时，主语是复数，谓语用复数；三种情况例外仍用单数：两个名词指同一人或同一事物、并列主语由 each/every/no 修饰、and 连接的是被视为一体的固定组合。判定顺序是：先看限定词是否重复，再看是否有 each/every/no，最后才按复数处理。

sections.p: 判定依据是限定词的数量。两个名词前只有一个限定词，说明是同一人兼两个身份，谓语用单数；两个名词各有自己的限定词，说明是两个人，谓语用复数。
bullets: My friend and colleague is coming.（一个人，一个 my）
My friend and my colleague are coming.（两个人，两个 my）
The poet and novelist has won the prize.（同一人，一个 the）
A knife and fork is on the table.（视为一副餐具）

sections.h: each / every / no 修饰的并列主语
sections.p: 这类限定词把每个并列成分单独处理，谓语一律用单数。判定信号是限定词重复出现。
bullets: Every boy and every girl was given a gift.
No teacher and no student is allowed to smoke here.
Each man and each woman has a vote.
In every room and every corridor there was a notice.

sections.p: bread and butter、fish and chips、a knife and fork 这类组合被视为一个整体，用单数。完整顺序是：同指检查 → each/every/no 检查 → 其余按复数。and 连接两个不定式或两个从句作主语时，也按复数处理。
bullets: Bread and butter is all he asked for.
Fish and chips is my favourite dish.
Reading and writing are two basic skills.
To love and to be loved is what everyone wants.（两个不定式指同一件事，用单数）

examples.en: Bread and butter is all he asked for.
examples.zh: 他只想要面包加黄油。
examples.note: bread and butter 被视为一种食物组合，谓语用单数。

examples.en: The manager and the secretary were both absent.
examples.zh: 经理和秘书都缺席了。
examples.note: 两个名词各有定冠词，指两个人，谓语用复数。

examples.en: Every seat and every table was checked before the opening.
examples.zh: 开业前每个座位和每张桌子都检查过了。
examples.note: every 重复修饰并列主语，每个成分单独处理，谓语用单数。

examples.en: Reading and writing are two basic skills.
examples.zh: 读和写是两项基本技能。
examples.note: 两个不同概念并列，谓语用复数。

examples.en: My friend and colleague are both coming to dinner.
examples.zh: 我的朋友兼同事要来吃晚饭。
examples.note: 只有一个限定词 my，指同一个人，谓语应改为 is coming。

examples.en: Every boy and every girl were invited to the party.
examples.zh: 每个男孩和每个女孩都被邀请参加聚会。
examples.note: every 重复修饰，谓语应按单数处理，改为 was invited。

examples.en: Both the teacher and the students were satisfied.
examples.zh: 老师和学生们都很满意。
examples.note: both...and 明确指两组人，谓语用复数 were。

pitfalls.wrong: A writer and poet have been invited to the forum.
pitfalls.right: A writer and poet has been invited to the forum.
pitfalls.why: 只有一个冠词 a，指身兼作家与诗人的同一个人，谓语用单数。

pitfalls.wrong: No boy and no girl are allowed to enter without permission.
pitfalls.right: No boy and no girl is allowed to enter without permission.
pitfalls.why: no 重复修饰并列主语，每个成分单独处理，谓语用单数。

pitfalls.wrong: Fish and chips are my favourite dish.
pitfalls.right: Fish and chips is my favourite dish.
pitfalls.why: 该组合被视为一道菜，是一个整体概念，谓语用单数。

contrast.diff: and 连接的是并列并列关系，默认按复数；either...or / not only...but also 连接的是选择关系，按就近原则。

concept.mnemonic: 先数限定词，再看 each/every/no，都没有才当复数。

core: and 连接两个不同主体，谓语用复数
只有一个限定词说明同指一人或一物，谓语用单数
each/every/no 重复修饰并列主语，每个成分单独处理，谓语用单数
固定组合视为一个整体，用单数：bread and butter, fish and chips
判定顺序：同指 → each/every/no → 其余按复数
review.trigger: 看到 and 先数限定词，只有一个限定词就是同指，谓语用单数

quickCheck.q: My friend and colleague ___ (be) coming. 填什么？
Every boy and every girl ___ (be) invited. 填什么？
Bread and butter ___ (be) all he asked for. 填什么？

drills.stem: The composer and conductor ___ the audience with a new piece last night.
drills.answer: astonished
drills.explain: 只有一个定冠词 the，指身兼作曲家与指挥家的同一个人，主语为单数；last night 要求过去式 astonished。
drills.trap: were astonishing 把两个身份当成两个人，与同指关系冲突。

drills.stem: Every classroom and every corridor ___ (be) cleaned before the new term.
drills.answer: is
drills.hint: 注意 every 出现了几次。
drills.explain: 触发语法一致中的 each/every 规则：every 重复修饰并列主语，每个成分单独处理，谓语用单数 is。

drills.stem: My friend and colleague are flying to Berlin tomorrow.
drills.answer: My friend and colleague is flying to Berlin tomorrow.
accept: My friend and colleague is flying to Berlin tomorrow.
drills.explain: 只有一个限定词 my，friend 与 colleague 指同一个人，主语为单数，进行时的 be 动词用 is。

drills.stem: Bread and butter ___ what he usually has for breakfast.
drills.answer: is
drills.explain: bread and butter 被视为一种食物组合，是单一概念，谓语用单数 is。
drills.trap: are 机械套用「and 连接即复数」，忽略了固定组合的整体性。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Every boy and every girl was given a gift.
drills.explain: every 重复修饰并列主语，每个成分单独处理，谓语用单数 was。

drills.stem: 我的邻居兼同事是一位医生。
drills.answer: My neighbour and colleague is a doctor.
drills.explain: 只有一个限定词 my，neighbour 与 colleague 指同一个人，谓语用单数 is。

items.title: 不定代词作主语的一致
items.brief: 复合不定代词一律单数，both/all 看所指

concept.summary: 不定代词作主语分三组：以 -one/-body/-thing 结尾的复合不定代词、each/either/neither/many a 一律单数；both/few/a few/many/several 一律复数；all/some/none/most/half/the rest 由所指对象决定，指不可数用单数，指可数复数用复数。判定顺序是先给代词分组，再看 of 后的名词。

sections.p: 这一组的单复数由词本身固定，与后面跟什么无关。判定时看到这些词就直接写单数谓语，不必再分析。
bullets: everyone, everybody, everything, someone, somebody, something
anyone, anybody, anything, no one, nobody, nothing
each, either, neither, one
many a + 单数名词；one of + 复数名词

sections.p: 表示「多个」的代词与限定词，谓语一律用复数。
bullets: both, few, a few, many, several, others
Both of the twins are good at maths.
Several of the students have already left.

sections.h: 两可组：看 of 后的名词
sections.p: all/some/none/most/half/part/the rest/plenty 本身不携带数，谓语由它们所指代的名词决定。判定动作是把 of 后的名词拿出来单独判断可数性。
bullets: Some of the water is polluted.（不可数 → 单数）
Some of the students are absent.（复数 → 复数）
None of the money was found.（不可数 → 单数）
Most of the guests have arrived.（复数 → 复数）

examples.en: Everyone in the office has read the notice.
examples.zh: 办公室里的每个人都看过通知了。
examples.note: everyone 是单数，现在完成时的助动词用 has。

examples.en: Neither of the two proposals makes sense.
examples.zh: 这两份提案都说不通。
examples.note: neither 是单数中心词，谓语用 makes。

examples.en: Many a student has struggled with this rule.
examples.zh: 许多学生都在这条规则上犯过难。
examples.note: many a + 单数名词作主语，谓语用单数 has。

examples.en: Both of the twins are good at maths.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎都擅长数学。
examples.note: both 是复数，谓语用 are。

examples.en: Each of the rooms have its own bathroom.
examples.zh: 每个房间都有独立浴室。
examples.note: each 是单数中心词，谓语应改为 has。

examples.en: Some of the equipment are out of order.
examples.zh: 有些设备出了故障。
examples.note: equipment 不可数，some 指不可数时谓语用单数 is。

examples.en: None of the information was accurate.
examples.zh: 这些信息没有一条是准确的。
examples.note: information 不可数，none 指不可数用单数 was。

pitfalls.wrong: Everybody in the class know the answer.
pitfalls.right: Everybody in the class knows the answer.
pitfalls.why: 复合不定代词一律单数，介词短语不改变它的数。

pitfalls.wrong: Neither of the two plans work.
pitfalls.right: Neither of the two plans works.
pitfalls.why: neither 是单数中心词，of 后的复数名词只是修饰语。

pitfalls.wrong: Many a ship have sunk in these waters.
pitfalls.right: Many a ship has sunk in these waters.
pitfalls.why: many a 后接单数名词，主语为单数，谓语用 has。

contrast.withTitle: 数量短语作主语的一致
contrast.diff: 不定代词的一致由词本身固定；数量短语的一致由短语的中心词位置或 of 后名词的可数性决定。

concept.mnemonic: body、one、thing 都是单数；both、few、many 都是复数；all、some、none 看后面。

core: -one/-body/-thing 结尾的复合不定代词一律单数
each/either/neither/one/many a 作主语用单数
both/few/a few/many/several 作主语用复数
all/some/none/most/half/the rest 看所指：不可数用单数，复数用复数
代词回指要与谓语的数一致：Everyone has his or her own view.
review.trigger: 看到 -body/-one/-thing 直接写单数谓语，不再往后分析

quickCheck.q: Everybody ___ (know) the answer. 填什么？
Some of the equipment ___ (be) out of order. 填什么？
many a student 后的谓语用单数还是复数？

drills.stem: Many a writer ___ tried to describe the city in a single sentence.
drills.answer: has
drills.explain: many a 后接单数名词 writer，主语为单数，现在完成时的助动词用 has。
drills.trap: have 是看到 many 就判复数的机械反应，忽略了 many a 的固定结构。

drills.stem: Neither of the two proposals ___ (make) economic sense.
drills.answer: makes
drills.hint: 先划掉 of the two proposals。
drills.explain: 触发语法一致原则：neither 是单数中心词，of the two proposals 只是修饰语，谓语用第三人称单数 makes。

drills.stem: Some of the equipment in the lab are out of order.
drills.answer: Some of the equipment in the lab is out of order.
accept: Some of the equipment in the lab is out of order.
drills.explain: some 的数由所指对象决定，equipment 是不可数名词，谓语须用单数 is。

drills.stem: Most of the water in the lake ___ frozen since December.
drills.answer: has
drills.explain: most 的数由 of 后的名词决定，water 不可数，谓语用单数 has been frozen 中的 has。
drills.trap: have 是按 most 表示「大多数」的直觉判断，没有检查 of 后的 water 是否可数。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Each of the rooms has its own bathroom.
drills.explain: each 是单数中心词，of the rooms 只是修饰语，谓语用 has。

drills.stem: 班上每个人都同意这个计划。
drills.answer: Everyone in the class agrees with the plan.
forbid: everyone in the class agree with
drills.explain: everyone 是单数复合不定代词，介词短语 in the class 不改变数，谓语用 agrees。

items.title: 定语从句与 one of 结构的主谓一致
items.brief: 从句谓语跟先行词一致，不跟关系代词

concept.summary: 定语从句的谓语与先行词一致，而不是与紧邻的关系代词或从句内的其他名词一致。判定顺序是：先确定先行词，再看先行词的单复数，最后处理 one of 结构的两个方向。主句谓语与从句谓语各自独立判定，同一句里可能出现两个不同的数。

sections.p: 关系代词 who/which/that 本身没有单复数，它继承先行词的数。找到先行词后，把从句单独拿出来当作一个句子看谓语。
bullets: The books that are on the shelf belong to me.（先行词 books）
The book that is on the shelf belongs to me.
He is the only one of the students who has passed.
I, who am your teacher, must warn you.

sections.h: one of 结构的两个方向
sections.p: one of + 复数名词 + 定语从句，从句谓语通常用复数，因为先行词是复数名词；但 one 前有 the only/the very/最高级限定时，先行词变为 one，从句谓语用单数。
bullets: She is one of the students who were chosen.（先行词 students）
She is the only one of the students who was chosen.（先行词 one）
This is the best one of the films that has been produced.
He is one of the few people who understand the theory.

sections.p: 带定语从句的句子里有两个谓语，各按各的主语定数。the number of + 复数名词 + who 的结构最容易被误判：从句跟复数名词，主句跟单数 number。
bullets: The number of students who have applied is increasing.（从句 have，主句 is）
The students who have applied are waiting outside.（两处都是复数）
先行词本身是集合名词或数量短语时，再叠加意义一致或数量短语规则

examples.en: The girl who lives next door is a pianist.
examples.zh: 住在隔壁的女孩是钢琴家。
examples.note: 先行词 the girl 单数，从句与主句的谓语都用单数。

examples.en: The girls who live next door are pianists.
examples.zh: 住在隔壁的那些女孩是钢琴家。
examples.note: 先行词 the girls 复数，从句与主句的谓语都用复数。

examples.en: This is one of the best novels that have been written on the subject.
examples.zh: 这是关于这个主题写得最好的小说之一。
examples.note: 先行词是 novels，从句谓语用复数 have。

examples.en: He is the only one of the applicants who has experience.
examples.zh: 他是求职者中唯一有经验的人。
examples.note: the only one 使先行词变为 one，从句谓语用单数 has。

examples.en: The books that is on the shelf belong to me.
examples.zh: 书架上的那些书是我的。
examples.note: 先行词 books 是复数，从句谓语应改为 are。

examples.en: She is one of the students who has won the scholarship.
examples.zh: 她是获得奖学金的学生之一。
examples.note: 先行词是 students，从句谓语应改为 have；只有在 the only one of 时从句才用单数。

examples.en: I, who am your teacher, must warn you.
examples.zh: 作为你的老师，我必须提醒你。
examples.note: 先行词是 I，从句谓语用 am，与主句的 must 各自独立。

pitfalls.wrong: The number of students who has applied is increasing.
pitfalls.right: The number of students who have applied is increasing.
pitfalls.why: 从句先行词是 students，从句用复数 have；主句主语是 number，主句用单数 is。

pitfalls.wrong: He is the only one of the boys who have passed the test.
pitfalls.right: He is the only one of the boys who has passed the test.
pitfalls.why: the only one of 使先行词变为 one，从句谓语改为单数。

pitfalls.wrong: There are many people who wants to help.
pitfalls.right: There are many people who want to help.
pitfalls.why: 先行词 people 是复数，从句谓语用复数；people 本身就是复数名词。

contrast.withTitle: one of 与 the only one of
contrast.diff: one of + 复数名词时先行词是复数名词，从句用复数；the only one of + 复数名词时先行词是 one，从句用单数。

concept.mnemonic: 先找先行词，再看单复数；one of 用复数，the only one 用单数。

core: 从句谓语跟先行词，关系代词本身没有单复数
先定先行词，再定从句的数，最后单独判主句
one of + 复数名词 + who → 从句用复数
the only one of + 复数名词 + who → 从句用单数
同一句的主句与从句可能各用各的数，必须分开判断
review.trigger: 看到 who/which/that，先回指先行词，再定从句谓语

quickCheck.q: She is one of the students who ___ (have) won. 填什么？
She is the only one of the students who ___ (have) won. 填什么？
The number of students who ___ (have) applied is rising. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: have，从句先行词是 students，主句的 is 不变。

drills.stem: This is one of the few films that ___ the reality of war without sentimentality.
drills.answer: portray
drills.explain: one of the few films 中先行词是 films，复数，从句谓语用 portray。
drills.trap: portrays 把先行词当成了 one，只有在 the only one of / the very one of 结构中先行词才是 one。

drills.stem: He is the only one of the candidates who ___ (meet) all the requirements.
drills.answer: meets
drills.hint: 注意 one 前的 the only。
drills.explain: 触发语法一致原则：the only one of 使先行词变为单数 one，从句谓语用第三人称单数 meets。

drills.stem: The number of students who has registered for the course is rising.
drills.answer: The number of students who have registered for the course is rising.
accept: The number of students who have registered for the course is rising.
drills.explain: 从句先行词是 students，从句谓语用复数 have；主句主语是 the number，主句谓语 is 正确，不受影响。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The books that are on the shelf belong to me.
drills.explain: 先行词 books 是复数，从句谓语用 are，主句谓语用 belong，两处都是复数。

drills.stem: 她是唯一一个通过考试的学生。
drills.answer: She is the only one of the students who has passed the exam.
forbid: one of the students who have passed
drills.explain: the only one of 使先行词变为单数 one，从句谓语用 has passed；若去掉 only，则先行词变回 students，从句要用 have passed。

drills.stem: There are many volunteers who ___ to work on weekends.
drills.answer: are willing
drills.explain: 先行词 volunteers 是复数，从句谓语用 are willing；主句的 There are 也印证了复数。
drills.trap: is willing 会被紧邻的 who 误导，把关系代词当成单数主语。

items.title: 数量短语作主语的一致
items.brief: the number 用单数，a number 用复数

concept.summary: 数量短语作主语时，谓语由中心词决定，不由 of 后的名词决定。三种情况：the number of / the amount of / the percentage of 的中心词是 number/amount/percentage，用单数；a number of / a great many / a few 的中心词是后面的复数名词，用复数；分数、百分数、half of、the rest of 则看 of 后的名词是否可数。

sections.h: 中心词在 of 前还是后
sections.p: 这是本知识点唯一的分界线。加 the 时中心词在前，用单数；加 a 时中心词在后，用复数。判定动作是看冠词，而不是看 of 后面。
bullets: The number of applicants has risen.（中心词 number，单数）
A number of applicants have withdrawn.（中心词 applicants，复数）
The amount of waste is increasing.（中心词 amount，单数）
A great deal of money was spent.（中心词 deal，单数）
A great many students were absent.（中心词 students，复数）

sections.h: 分数、百分数与 half of
sections.p: 这类结构没有固定中心词，谓语跟 of 后的名词：可数复数用复数，不可数或单数用单数。
bullets: Two thirds of the students are against it.
Two thirds of the land is covered by forest.
Half of the cake was eaten.
Seventy percent of the surface is water.

sections.p: 表示长度、重量、金额、时间的复数名词作主语时，视为一个整体量，谓语用单数。但若强调一个个个体或具体年头，则用复数。
bullets: Ten kilometres is a long way to walk.
Three plus five is eight.
Twenty years have passed since we met.（强调流逝的多个年头）
Two hours is enough for this task.

examples.en: The number of bicycles on campus has doubled.
examples.zh: 校园里自行车的数量翻了一番。
examples.note: 中心词是 number，单数，谓语用 has。

examples.en: A number of bicycles were stolen last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有不少自行车被盗。
examples.note: a number of 的中心词是 bicycles，复数，谓语用 were。

examples.en: Nearly seventy percent of the surface is covered with water.
examples.zh: 近百分之七十的表面被水覆盖。
examples.note: of 后 surface 不可数，谓语用单数 is。

examples.en: Nearly seventy percent of the students wear glasses.
examples.zh: 近百分之七十的学生戴眼镜。
examples.note: of 后 students 是复数，谓语用复数 wear。

examples.en: The number of cars are increasing rapidly.
examples.zh: 汽车的数量正在迅速增加。
examples.note: 中心词是 number，单数，谓语应改为 is increasing。

examples.en: A number of problems has arisen.
examples.zh: 出现了许多问题。
examples.note: a number of 的中心词是 problems，谓语应改为 have arisen。

examples.en: A great deal of time was wasted on paperwork.
examples.zh: 大量时间浪费在文书工作上。
examples.note: a great deal of 修饰不可数名词，中心词 deal 单数，谓语用 was。

pitfalls.wrong: The amount of plastic waste have increased.
pitfalls.right: The amount of plastic waste has increased.
pitfalls.why: 中心词是 amount，单数，of plastic waste 只是修饰语。

pitfalls.wrong: A great many student has applied.
pitfalls.right: A great many students have applied.
pitfalls.why: a great many 修饰可数名词复数，中心词是 students，谓语用复数。

pitfalls.wrong: Half of the apples was rotten.
pitfalls.right: Half of the apples were rotten.
pitfalls.why: of 后是可数复数 apples，谓语用复数。

contrast.withTitle: 不定代词作主语的一致
contrast.diff: 不定代词的一致由词本身固定；数量短语的一致由中心词位置与 of 后名词的可数性决定。

concept.mnemonic: the number 单数，a number 复数；加了 the 中心在前，加了 a 中心在后。

core: the number / amount / percentage of → 单数
a number of / a great many / a few → 复数
分数、百分数、half of、the rest of → 看 of 后名词是否可数
时间、距离、金额、运算视为整体 → 单数
判定动作：先看冠词定位中心词，再看 of 后的名词
review.trigger: 看到 the number of 与 a number of，立刻分清中心词在 of 前还是后

quickCheck.q: The number of applicants ___ (have) risen. 填什么？
A number of applicants ___ (have) withdrawn. 填什么？
Two thirds of the land ___ (be) covered by forest. 填什么？

drills.stem: The number of overseas students at the university ___ steadily over the past five years.
drills.answer: has grown
drills.explain: the number of 的中心词是 number，单数，over the past five years 要求现在完成时，用 has grown。
drills.trap: have grown 把 of 后的复数 students 当成中心词，这是 the number of 与 a number of 最典型的混淆。

drills.stem: A number of trees ___ (be) blown down in last night's storm.
drills.answer: were
drills.hint: 先看冠词是 a 还是 the。
drills.explain: 触发语法一致中的数量短语规则：a number of 的中心词是复数 trees，谓语用 were，而不是与 number 一致。

drills.stem: The amount of plastic waste in the ocean have doubled in ten years.
drills.answer: The amount of plastic waste in the ocean has doubled in ten years.
accept: The amount of plastic waste in the ocean has doubled in ten years.
drills.explain: 中心词是 amount，单数，of plastic waste 只是修饰语，现在完成时的助动词用 has。

drills.stem: Two thirds of the land in this region ___ covered by forest.
drills.answer: is
drills.explain: 分数结构作主语时谓语跟 of 后的名词，land 不可数，用单数 is。
drills.trap: are 是按 two thirds 的复数形式判断，忽略了 of 后才是决定谓语的成分。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: A number of students were absent yesterday.
drills.explain: a number of 的中心词是复数 students，谓语用 were，与 number 的形式无关。

drills.stem: 校园里自行车的数量翻了一番。
drills.answer: The number of bicycles on campus has doubled.
drills.explain: 主语中心词是 the number，单数，of bicycles 只是修饰语，现在完成时用 has doubled。
